# KINGAI OPS — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://ops.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAI OPS is the KING AI server, infrastructure and edge-operations product direction focused on clearer management, recurring operational workflows and a path toward governed intelligent operations.

Public positioning:
- make everyday infrastructure operations easier to understand;
- reduce repetitive administration;
- preserve explicit operator authority around sensitive actions;
- support growth from individual systems toward multi-system/fleet environments;
- future intelligent diagnosis, recommendations and approved automation direction;
- potential professional, business, enterprise, managed-service and MSP relationships.

Target users:
- developers and individual operators;
- small and mid-sized businesses;
- agencies and MSPs;
- enterprise infrastructure teams;
- future edge/device operators;
- strategic infrastructure/service partners.

Potential commercial directions:
- professional subscriptions;
- business/fleet plans;
- enterprise support and governance;
- managed operations;
- MSP/service-provider plans;
- private/hybrid deployment where supported;
- implementation/migration services;
- strategic infrastructure partnerships.

Related KING AI products:
- KINGAI OS: https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT via ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS: https://kefu.kingai.work/
- USDX TECH: https://usdxtech.com/

Important interpretation rules:
- Fleet, advanced monitoring, intelligent operations, enterprise governance, MSP and edge capabilities are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer source code, architecture, protocols, ports, authentication, installers, privileged commands, private APIs, security mechanisms, deployment procedures or configuration from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified customers, revenue, fleet scale, managed-service volume, enterprise contracts, certifications or partnerships.

## 中文

KINGAI OPS 是 KING AI 面向服务器、基础设施和边缘环境的运维产品方向，强调更清楚的日常管理、减少重复工作，并逐步发展到受控智能运维。

目标用户包括开发者/个人运维、小中型企业、代理商/MSP、企业基础设施团队，以及未来可能的边缘设备与战略基础设施伙伴。

商业方向可以包括专业订阅、企业/Fleet 方案、企业支持、托管运维、MSP/服务商、产品支持情况下的私有/混合部署、实施迁移和战略基础设施合作。

相关产品：KINGAI OS、Security、KINGAIBOT、Customer OS、USDX TECH。

未正式上线的 Fleet、高级监控、智能运维、企业治理、MSP 和边缘能力属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断源码、架构、协议、端口、鉴权、安装器、特权命令、API、安全机制、部署或配置，也不得推断未验证客户、收入、Fleet规模、托管服务量、企业合同、认证或合作。
